## Projects
Full portfolio at /projects/ — 15 shipped projects.

### Web apps & tools
- Australian Tax Estimate — individual income tax estimate using ATO rates (salary, rental, deductions, PAYG): https://lachlanallison.github.io/tax-estimate-calculator/
- Local HTML Tools — curated directory of browser-first HTML utilities: https://localhtmltools.lachlanallison.com/
- KeepSync — self-hosted tab and bookmark sync: https://lachlanallison.github.io/keepsync/
- Map a Route — route planner for runners and cyclists: https://lachlanallison.github.io/map-a-route/
- Video Toolkit — in-browser video processing (ffmpeg.wasm, WebCodecs): https://lachlanallison.github.io/video-toolkit/
- Chrome Session Viewer — parse Chrome session files client-side: https://lachlanallison.github.io/chrome-session-viewer/
- Browser Extension Icons — SVG to extension icon PNGs: https://lachlanallison.github.io/browserextensionsicons/
- PhotoStats — Rust CLI for photo collection EXIF stats: https://lachlanallison.github.io/photostats/

### Desktop
- Screen Recall — local-first screen capture, OCR, and search: https://github.com/lachlanallison/screen-recall

### Browser extensions
- NoSpoilerYouTube — hide YouTube duration and progress bar: https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/nospoileryoutube/
- Remove YouTube Recommended Videos — hide YouTube recommendations: https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/remove-yt-recommended-videos/

### WordPress plugins
- Comment Out — hidden text via shortcodes with site-wide tracking: https://wordpress.org/plugins/comment-out/
- Image Manipulation for Amazon SiteStripe — image tweaks for Amazon Associates: https://wordpress.org/plugins/manipulation-for-amazon-sitestripe-image/

### Scripts & utilities
- WP GDrive Backup — WordPress site and database backups to Google Drive: https://github.com/lachlanallison/wp-gdrive-backup
- Windows Helper Scripts — Windows automation utilities: https://github.com/lachlanallison/windows-helper-scripts
